scientific_integrity: The exact result is proved for Haar-random linear two-plane projections of the centered three-cube and for the specified upper-tail range. Small-radius behavior outside that range is not claimed; analytic proof is distinct from supporting numerical tests.
scientific_limitations: The lower-radius distribution and analogous laws for nonsymmetric boxes or other dimensions are not established.
Independent mathematical validation and definitive historical-priority checking remain outstanding.
title: Exact high-circumradius law for random planar cube shadows
